module.title: Parallel-Kinetic-Perpendicular-Moment Solvers
entrypoints: pkpm/luareg/ (Lua PKPM inputs through the gkeyll executable)
module.expensive_path: Coupled parallel kinetic distribution updates and perpendicular fluid-moment/Maxwell updates, including DG fluxes, primitive-moment recovery, limiters, source coupling, and velocity-space reductions.
module.rationale: PKPM is a separate reduced kinetic formulation with a smaller phase-space representation and a dedicated application layer and regression corpus, making it a coherent task boundary despite depending on lower Gkeyll layers.
excluded: General full-f gyrokinetic and full Vlasov solvers are separate modules.
Shared communication, arrays, basis, and I/O remain in core.
hazards: PKPM transitively builds all lower physics layers, increasing build time and task-image size.
No PKPM executable was completed within the bounded local full-stack build investigation.
